attribution: Atomic polarizabilities and one constant per molecule, fitted by this project (benchmarks/polarizability/PREREGISTRATION.md and PREREGISTRATION_2.md, refit2.py, RESULT.md) to the experimental polarizabilities of 425 solvents in Bosque and Sales, J. Chem. Inf. Comput. Sci. 42, 1154 (2002), Tables 1 and 2, and of 264 further molecules in the CRC Handbook's table of atomic and molecular polarizabilities (97th ed., T. M. Miller). The values are ours; the data are the papers'. Weighted least squares on the relative error.
units: cubic angstrom (A^3), isotropic: the sum of the element values over every atom including hydrogens, plus one constant per molecule

constant.meaning: added once per molecule; it absorbs that small molecules are more polarizable per atom than an additive scheme fitted on larger ones says, and is not a physical quantity

B.reason: no molecule containing it in the fitting data

Se.reason: no molecule containing it in the fitting data
